title: UPDATE: Grok Bot Adds Native X Search and Opus 5.5 Support

tickers.name: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A Common Stock

summary:
The AI tool now synthesizes information from more than 100 platform posts in a single prompt to eliminate previous dependencies on external web connectors or separate search tools. This native integration allows Grok Bot to pull data directly from X to perform mention checks and activity monitoring, though the ability to publish posts remains restricted to human users while the agent handles drafting.

The update is one of two upgrades delivered within 24 hours, the other being the integration of the Opus 5.5 model. These features, including the persistent monitoring of live discussions, are available to users at no additional cost to improve the speed and volume of post analysis.
